prompt:
SUMMARY: hairstyle a high straight ponytail with blunt eyebrow-length fringe and close-cropped temple sections; costume silhouette angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; design idea The pauldrons are stepped in three layers that converge toward one central breastplate, a structural sign of three realms unified. face original world-specific features; expression proud, poised closed-lip smile.
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Sima Yan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the founder of Jin who opened its gates at the end of the Three Kingdoms.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a regal, imperious haughtiness; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; low heavy brows; broad soft nose; small bow lips; near-black obsidian eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; a high straight ponytail with blunt eyebrow-length fringe and close-cropped temple sections; bright red hair.
Expression: a proud, poised look with a faint closed-lip smile, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: imperial splendor and ambition, the first Jin emperor's regalia.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MEDIEVAL FANTASY
Costume: a medieval monarch's regalia — a crown or circlet, an ornate breastplate under a fur-trimmed royal mantle, heraldic embroidery in her faction's colours, a sword of state. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, with a subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows through her signature item, her colours and her bearing.
Silhouette: angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: The pauldrons are stepped in three layers that converge toward one central breastplate, a structural sign of three realms unified.
Colours: deep plum purple, black lacquer, silver and pale gold.
Signature item: an imperial jade seal, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders (bare shoulders only where no shoulder guard sits), a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, the tabard or gown cut with a high side slit at full length — it shows the side line of one leg as she stands, no leg pushed out or knee bent for it; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a stern northern empire of medieval high fantasy: black-stone citadels with blue banners, iron-shod heavy cavalry, snowy plains and pine forests, a court ruled by strict law, cold blue sigil-magic.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She cups the seal in her right palm with her left arm hanging naturally beside her cape.
Setting detail: An open Gothic arch frames a snowy valley behind her.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A Western medieval setting and dress only — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture — with no Chinese architecture, robes or hanzi.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
